title: Founder Demo Script Page

demoScript.title: Open the Local Evidence Index
demoScript.talkingPoint: This page collects the proof of the Yamaha parser validation and dry-run writer safety work.

demoScript.talkingPoint: The CTO summary explains what is ready locally and what is intentionally blocked.

demoScript.title: Show Dry-run Manifest Viewer
demoScript.talkingPoint: The system simulates writer output safely as JSON-only manifests, not keyboard files.

demoScript.title: Show Final Decision Gate
demoScript.talkingPoint: The next safe decision is UI polish and dry-run improvement, not real writer or deploy.

demoScript.title: Close with the Safety Position
demoScript.talkingPoint: UAOS is a local proof-of-technology package. Real writer, production parser, real keyboard output, and deploy are blocked.

founderMessage: Show value clearly, then show safety clearly.
